Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Once a package has been dispatched, we are generally unable to change the shipping address or reroute the delivery through our warehouse.
However, depending on the courier handling your delivery, you may be able to contact them directly using your tracking number to request a delivery hold or package reroute.

Do you compensate for a long delay?
We don't offer standard compensation for shipping delays, as delivery estimates are provided directly by courier services and can occasionally vary due to transit factors.
However, if your order is significantly delayed, please share your order number and email address so we can check on its status, or reach out to our support team to look into it for you!
